purpose: A reviewed registry of public source APIs that may be used to discover open-source repositories. Registry entries describe sources; they do not certify projects.

sources.name: GitHub public repositories
sources.authentication: Optional token for higher rate limits; never store tokens in catalogue data
sources.pagination: Use API pagination and stop at provider limits
constraints: Search results are relevance-ranked and incomplete
Search API has separate rate limits
Repository metadata is not a security or quality assessment

sources.name: GitLab public projects
sources.authentication: Public project discovery can use unauthenticated requests; never store tokens in catalogue data
sources.pagination: Use keyset or page pagination as documented and respect instance limits
constraints: Only public projects are in scope
Instance policies and rate limits apply

sources.name: Codeberg public repositories
sources.authentication: Use public endpoints where available; never store tokens in catalogue data
sources.pagination: Follow the instance API pagination behavior and documented limits
constraints: Codeberg is one Forgejo host, not the whole Forgejo ecosystem
Do not assume every Forgejo instance permits anonymous discovery

sources.name: User-configured public Forgejo instances
sources.authentication: Public unauthenticated endpoints only; no credentials are sent to configured instances.
sources.pagination: Respect each host's documented limits and robots or acceptable-use policies
constraints: Only explicitly enabled HTTPS hosts in data/discovery-config.json are queried
API and repository URLs must use the same configured host
Hostnames must be public DNS names; local, loopback and IP-literal targets are rejected
Redirects are blocked; network-level egress controls are still recommended
Each host must be reviewed by a maintainer before enabling

sources.name: Gitea.com public repositories
sources.authentication: Public endpoints only; never store tokens in catalogue data
sources.pagination: Use documented page and limit parameters and respect instance rate limits
constraints: Only public repository metadata is in scope
Gitea.com is one host, not the entire Gitea ecosystem
Do not assume arbitrary Gitea instances permit anonymous discovery

record_requirements: Keep the original source URL and provider identifier.
Record when and how the record was discovered.
Normalize repository URLs before duplicate comparison.
Do not treat missing fields as zero or false.
Queue candidates for human review before adding them to data/projects.json.
